title: Generic artifact schema
description: Base schema for all artifacts validated by the deterministic orchestration harness. Methodology-specific artifact schemas in artifacts/ extend this base via a top-level $ref (structural base, per the GSM convention; allOf is reserved for if/then facets). The harness is agnostic to the methodology that owns the artifact; this base only supplies the generic object shape and the one universal identity field (slug).

artifactPath.description: Workspace-relative path of an artifact — the shared definition every contract naming an artifact path references.

slug.description: URL-safe, human-identifying slug for the artifact — the ONE generic display/identity field every artifact schema should rely on rather than locally re-defining an equivalent 'title' property.

provenance.description: Reserved for the harness-owned artifact provenance (`provenance.sessionId`: the session whose harness commit last changed the instance). It is derived by the harness from its own commit attribution and exposed to condition expressions on every artifact kind; an artifact's own data never carries it, so a document supplying it is invalid (the harness refuses it as `reserved` before schema validation).
